title: Ad Tracking & Targeted Advertising Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your exposure to ad tracking and targeted advertising. Assess privacy risks and get personalized tips to stop behavioral advertising.
description: Evaluate how vulnerable you are to online ad tracking and behavioral advertising. This calculator analyzes your browsing habits, privacy settings, and protection measures to determine your risk level and provide actionable steps to reduce targeted advertising exposure.

inputs.label: Primary Browser Used
inputs.helpText: Different browsers have varying levels of built-in ad tracking protection

inputs.label: Do you use ad blockers or tracking protection?
inputs.helpText: Ad blockers and privacy tools significantly reduce tracking exposure

inputs.label: Cookie Management Settings
inputs.helpText: Third-party cookies are the primary method for cross-site tracking

inputs.label: Social Media Platform Usage (hours per day)
inputs.helpText: Social platforms extensively track users for targeted advertising

inputs.label: Online Shopping Frequency
inputs.helpText: E-commerce sites heavily track shopping behavior for retargeting

inputs.label: How often do you browse while logged into accounts?
inputs.helpText: Being logged in allows for more comprehensive profile building

inputs.label: Do you share devices with others?
inputs.helpText: Shared devices can lead to mixed advertising profiles

inputs.label: Location Services for Web Browsers
inputs.helpText: Location data enables highly targeted local advertising

outputFields.label: Ad Tracking Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall risk level from 0-100 based on your privacy exposure

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Categorized assessment of your ad tracking vulnerability

outputFields.label: Primary Vulnerability
outputFields.description: The biggest factor contributing to your tracking exposure

outputFields.label: Improvement Potential
outputFields.description: How much you could reduce tracking with recommended changes

formula: let browserScore = 0; switch(inputs.browserType) { case 'chrome': browserScore = 25; break; case 'firefox': browserScore = 15; break; case 'safari': browserScore = 10; break; case 'edge': browserScore = 20; break; case 'incognito': browserScore = 5; break; case 'other': browserScore = 15; break; } let adBlockerScore = 0; switch(inputs.adBlockerUsage) { case 'none': adBlockerScore = 30; break; case 'basic': adBlockerScore = 15; break; case 'advanced': adBlockerScore = 8; break; case 'comprehensive': adBlockerScore = 3; break; } let cookieScore = 0; switch(inputs.cookieSettings) { case 'accept-all': cookieScore = 25; break; case 'default': cookieScore = 20; break; case 'block-third-party': cookieScore = 10; break; case 'strict': cookieScore = 5; break; } let socialMediaScore = Math.min(inputs.socialMediaUsage * 2, 20); let shoppingScore = 0; switch(inputs.shoppingFrequency) { case 'rarely': shoppingScore = 3; break; case 'monthly': shoppingScore = 8; break; case 'weekly': shoppingScore = 15; break; case 'daily': shoppingScore = 20; break; } let accountScore = 0; switch(inputs.accountLoggedIn) { case 'never': accountScore = 2; break; case 'sometimes': accountScore = 8; break; case 'often': accountScore = 15; break; case 'always': accountScore = 20; break; } let deviceScore = inputs.deviceSharing ? 5 : 0; let locationScore = 0; switch(inputs.locationServices) { case 'disabled': locationScore = 2; break; case 'ask': locationScore = 8; break; case 'enabled': locationScore = 15; break; } let totalScore = browserScore + adBlockerScore + cookieScore + socialMediaScore + shoppingScore + accountScore + deviceScore + locationScore; let riskLevel = 'Low'; if(totalScore > 60) riskLevel = 'High'; else if(totalScore > 35) riskLevel = 'Medium'; let vulnerability = 'Cookie tracking'; if(adBlockerScore >= 15) vulnerability = 'No ad blocking protection'; else if(socialMediaScore >= 15) vulnerability = 'Extensive social media usage'; else if(accountScore >= 15) vulnerability = 'Frequent logged-in browsing'; let currentProtection = 100 - totalScore; let maxProtection = 85; let improvement = Math.max(0, (maxProtection - currentProtection) / maxProtection * 100); return { riskScore: Math.min(totalScore, 100), riskLevel: riskLevel, trackingVulnerability: vulnerability, improvementPotential: Math.round(improvement) };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your ad tracking risk by analyzing browser choice, privacy tools, cookie settings, and online behavior patterns. It considers the cumulative effect of various tracking methods including cookies, device fingerprinting, and behavioral profiling used by advertisers.
tips: Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser or Firefox with strict settings
Install comprehensive ad blockers like uBlock Origin and Privacy Badger
Configure your browser to block third-party cookies and tracking scripts
Limit social media usage and use private browsing for sensitive activities
Regularly clear cookies, browsing history, and use different browsers for different activities
Disable location services for non-essential websites and applications
Consider using a VPN to mask your IP address and location from advertisers
Review and adjust privacy settings on all social media and shopping accounts

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy protection. You're using effective tools and practices to minimize ad tracking exposure.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate tracking exposure. Consider implementing additional privacy measures to better protect your data.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant tracking vulnerability. Your online activities are likely being extensively monitored for advertising purposes.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum tracking exposure. Immediate action needed to protect your privacy from pervasive advertising surveillance.
